hss_fqdn.description: Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) of this HSS server.

hss_realm.description: Serving realm (MCC+MNC) for subscribers managed by this HSS.

hss_s6a_ip.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) on which the Diameter server listens for S6a connections.

hss_s6a_host_ip_advertise.description: Optional: IP address to advertise in Host-IP-Address AVP (useful for NAT/multi-homing). If empty, uses hss_s6a_ip.

hss_db_name.description: MongoDB database name for subscriber and subscription data.

hss_security_integrity_protected.description: Enable integrity protection for Diameter messages (S6a). Recommended true in production.

hss_security_confidentiality_protected.description: Enable confidentiality (encryption) for Diameter messages. Usually disabled unless required.

hss_default_apn_apn.description: Default APN name assigned to new subscribers.

hss_default_apn_pdn_type.description: PDN type supported for the default APN.

hss_default_apn_qci.description: QCI value for the default APN (e.g., 9 = best-effort internet traffic).

hss_default_apn_arp.description: Allocation and Retention Priority (ARP) for the default APN (1–15; lower = higher priority).

hss_default_apn_ambr_uplink.description: Default uplink AMBR (kbps) for new subscribers (e.g., 100 Mbps = 100000 kbps).

hss_default_apn_ambr_downlink.description: Default downlink AMBR (kbps) for new subscribers.

hss_mme_peers.description: List of MME peers this HSS communicates with via S6a.

realm.description: Optional: Realm served by this MME (if different from global hss_realm).

hss_log_file.description: Path to the HSS log file.

hss_metrics_port.description: Port to serve metrics on (when enabled).

hss_debug_gdb.description: Enable GDB debugging hooks (only for development).
